rdf:Description.rdfs:label: locatedAt
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: `from` element located at a specific `to` location. A time period is optional.
Identifies the size of a software Artifact, in bytes.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a License which has additional text applied to it.
A concrete subclass of AnyLicenseInfo used by Individuals in the ExpandedLicensing profile.
Class that describes an instance of VirtualHardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fullAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 5 - Full automation. The system is capable of performing its entire mission without external intervention.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isci
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: International Standard Collection Identifier (ISCI) is a variable-length identifier standardized by [ISO 27730](https://www.iso.org/standard/44293.html) for identifying collections held by libraries, archives, museums, and other memory institutions. It consists of two parts: the identifier for the assigning organization (an ISIL) enclosed in square brackets, followed by a local collection identifier string (e.g., `[FR-751041001]Casadesus1`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: underInvestigationFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability impact is being investigated for each `to` Element. The use of the `underInvestigationFor` type is constrained to `VexUnderInvestigationVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's design.
Specifies until when the artifact can be used before its usage needs to be reassessed.
Identifier for specific product is called a serial number.
Defines the byte range in the original host file that the snippet information applies to.
Refers to any unit of content that can be associated with a distribution of software.
An assertion made in relation to one or more elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a plan, guideline or strategy how to create, perform or analyze an application.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: chat
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the instant messaging system used by the maintainer for a package.
Provides a numerical (0-10) representation of the severity of a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data points in the dataset can be shared only with specific organizations and their clients on a need to know basis.
Identifies an external Element used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.
Specifies the time an artifact was built.
Specifies the version of a VEX statement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a failed evaluation where the requirement or condition is not met.
Specifies an Element contained in a piece of software where a vulnerability was found.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lite
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Lite profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kev
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerability (KEV) catalog.
The Boundary Definition Process refers to the process class used to produce boundaries.
An actual alteration of a product.
Class that describes an instance of Hardware.
A prescribed change to a product's location.
Class that describes a build instance of software/artifacts.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timeseries
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded in an ordered sequence of timestamped entries, such as the price of a stock over the course of a day.
Identifies who or what supplied the artifact or VulnAssessmentRelationship referenced by the Element.
The relative file name of a file to be excluded from the `PackageVerificationCode`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reportedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability was first reported to a project, vendor, or tracking database for formal identification by each `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hsCodes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Harmonized System (HS)](https://www.wcoomd.org/en/topics/nomenclature/overview/what-is-the-harmonized-system.aspx) of tariff nomenclature is an internationally standardized system of names and numbers, defined by the World Customs Organization, used to classify traded products.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDeletedFile
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a file deleted from the `from` Element (`from` hasDeletedFile `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 256, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.
Abstract class representing a License or an OrLaterOperator.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Core/IntegrityMethod is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: qualityAssessmentReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a quality assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: operations
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Operations profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasProvidedDependency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a dependency on each `to` Element, dependency is not in the distributed artifact, but assumed to be provided, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: email
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Email address, as defined in [RFC 3696](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3696/) Section 3.
Specifies the time an artifact was released.
A license that is listed on the SPDX License List.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: highAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 4 - High automation. The system performs parts of its mission without external intervention.
An actual change to a product's location.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: development
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during development phase of an element.
Verification preconditions are initial criteria that are to be met prior to initiating the verification method.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: registration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is not publicly available and an email registration is required before accessing the dataset, although without an affirmative acceptance of terms.
A collection of SPDX Elements that could potentially be serialized.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nuget
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a NuGet package. The package locator format is defined in the [NuGet documentation](https://docs.nuget.org) and looks like `package/version`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endOfSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is a defined end of support for the artifact from the supplier. This may also be referred to as end of life. There is a validUntilDate that can be used to signal when support ends for the artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: secureSoftwareAttestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to information assuring that the software is developed using security practices as defined by [NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final) or [CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/secure-software-development-attestation-form).
Identifies the tooling that was used during the creation of the Element.
A type of extension consisting of a list of name value pairs.
Timestamp, when an assessment was conducted.
A license or addition that is not listed on the SPDX License List.
Provides an EPSS assessment for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedIn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A `from` Vulnerability has been fixed in each `to` Element. The use of the `fixedIn` type is constrained to `VexFixedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.
The DefinedType class associates a specific type with its defined source.
The destruction process is defined in this process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when the type does not match any of the other options.
A mathematically calculated representation of a grouping of data.
Street address includes a street number, name and unit ID to identify a specific street.
This individual element was defined by the spec.
The point in time when an element or an action ends, becomes no longer applicable, or becomes no longer valid.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: resolved
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` OutOfSpecAction is resolved in the `from` ResolutionAction.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lei
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)](https://www.gleif.org/en/organizational-identity/introducing-the-legal-entity-identifier-lei) is a 20-character, alphanumeric code based on the [ISO 17442](https://www.iso.org/standard/78829.html) standard developed by the International Organization for Standardization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: red
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data points in the dataset are highly confidential and can only be shared with named recipients.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md2
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD2 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1319](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1319/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exportControlAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an export control assessment for a package.
Standard that an artifact is being complied with.
Provides advise on how to mitigate or remediate a vulnerability when a VEX product is affected by it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mavenCentral
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Maven repository artifact. The artifact locator format is defined in the [Maven documentation](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-naming-conventions.html) and looks like `groupId:artifactId[:version]`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during the execution phase of an element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: syntactic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data describes the syntax or semantics of a language or text, such as a parse tree used for natural language processing.
Information about the AI software, not including the model description.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Conducting controlled tests, experiments or simulations to verify that specific requirements regarding performance, functionality, robustness, etc. are met.
Information about different steps of the training process.
A known location is specified at this time.
A collection of SPDX Elements describing a single package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is the evidence that a specification or requirement has been fulfilled.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerabilityDisclosureReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Vulnerability Disclosure Report (VDR) which provides the software supplier's analysis and findings describing the impact (or lack of impact) that reported vulnerabilities have on packages or products in the supplier's SBOM as defined in [NIST SP 800-161 Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices for Systems and Organizations](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/161/r1/final).
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where only one of the elements applies.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTestCase
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a test case for the `from` Element (`from` hasTestCase `to`).
Provides a reference number that can be used to understand how to parse and interpret an Element.
Records if sensitive personal information is used during model training or could be used during the inference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: providesSupportFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent provides support for each `to` Artifact. Shall be a `SupportRelationship` type.
Base domain class from which all other SPDX 3 domain classes derive.
This is the state of an affected Element.
This is the agent that performed the act of destroying the item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tls
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Transport Layer Security, or TLS, is a widely adopted security protocol designed to facilitate privacy and data security for communications over the Internet.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: orcidid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) iD](https://info.orcid.org/what-is-orcid/) is a unique identifier for authors and contributors in scholarly communication; as a subset of the International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI), it typically appears as a URI such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`.
A Package that contains AI software or an AI model.
A distinct unit representing a requirement, as used in systems, software, and hardware engineering.
A concrete subclass of Element used by Individuals in the Core profile.
A prescribed alteration of a product.
A license exception that is listed on the SPDX Exceptions list.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: autonomous
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 6 - Autonomous. The system is capable of modifying its intended domain of use or its goals without external intervention, control or oversight.
ManufactureAction represents the act of creating a product by a manufacturing process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: decommission
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications for a product's retirement and/or decommissioning.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence with an upper level requirement. Typically done as peer review, offline review or review meeting.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: documentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is documentation.
This is the state of an affected Element at a specific moment in time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when someone reviews the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityThreatModel
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the [security threat model](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Threat_model) for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: follows
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` Element succeeds the `from` Element, establishing a unidirectional sequence. This succession is defined as chronological, procedural, or logical. It is used to represent either a temporal order (e.g., in a workflow) or a logical order for processing and traversal (e.g., in an ordered list).
A probability score between 0 and 1 of a vulnerability being exploited.
A prescribed change to a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: invokedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element was invoked by the `to` Agent, during a LifecycleScopeType period (for example, a Build element that describes a build step).
Identifies from where or whom the Element originally came.
A License participating in a 'with addition' model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: republishedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability's details were tracked, aggregated, and/or enriched to improve context (i.e. NVD) by each `to` Agent.
Denote whether a CVE is present in an exploit catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gln
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Location Number (GLN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gln) is a 13-digit number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a legal entity (e.g., a company or customer), a function within a legal entity, a physical location (e.g., a warehouse or a specific shelf in a store), or a digital location (e.g., an Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) gateway).

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Core/Element is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM of intended, planned software project or product with included components (some of which may not yet exist) for a new software artifact.
Type of support that is associated with an artifact.
Assessment of an Element for export control classification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: custody
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Custody refers to the responsibility, control, and safekeeping of an asset, person, or legal entity. It involves both physical possession and legal authority over something or someone.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data type is not known.
EvidenceRelationship defines the association between pieces of evidence and EvaluationResult.
A license addition that is not listed on the SPDX Exceptions List.
Describes how an Agent provides support for an Artifact.
Gives information about the circumstances or unifying properties that Elements of the bundle have been assembled under.
Provides a NamespaceMap of prefixes and associated namespace partial URIs applicable to an SpdxDocument and independent of any specific serialization format or instance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha224
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 224, as defined in [RFC 3874](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3874/).

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/SupplyChain/UseAction is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where all elements apply.
A value used in a key-value pair with a generic key that refers to an Element

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: glue
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [GLobal Unique Enterprise (GLUE) Identifiers](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-spice-glue-id/), as defined by the IETF Internet-Draft, is expressed as a GLUE URI, a Uniform Resource Identifier that standardizes the representation of existing organizational entity identifiers.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/SupplyChain/CreateProcess is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A property name with an associated value.
A group of people who work together in an organized way for a shared purpose.
A reference to a resource identifier defined outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ecli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Case Law Identifier (ECLI)](https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/european-case-law-identifier-ecli) is a uniform identifier for judicial decisions across Europe. It consists of five mandatory components: the "ECLI" prefix, a country code, a court code, the year of the decision, and a unique serial number (e.g., `ECLI:EU:C:2023:94`).
A collection of Elements, not necessarily with unifying context.
The measure of mass refers to the quantity of matter in an object or substance.
Specifies an Extension characterization of some aspect of an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element (the instructions) of runs on each `to` Hardware (processing element), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Points to a resource outside the scope of the SPDX 3 content that provides additional characteristics of an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inconclusive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). An inconclusive result means there was not enough clear evidence, data, or signal to make a definitive determination, and further investigation or additional testing is necessary. An inconclusive result always shall need a comment on it.
Specifies a vulnerability and its associated information.
Preprocessing steps that were applied to the raw data to create the given dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: staticAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a static analysis report for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: partialAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 2 - Partial automation or task automation. Some sub-functions of the system are fully automated while the system remain under control of an external agent. The system can perform actions for an approved task without requiring the agent's continuous direct control.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is related to the `from` Element where the relationship type is not described by any of the SPDX relationship types (this relationship is directionless).
An Element an annotator has made an assertion about.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: image
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is a collection of images such as pictures of animals.
Specifies a country code of the location.
The result of applying a hash algorithm to an Element.
Provides a CVSS version 4 assessment for a vulnerability.
Identifies who or what created the Element.
A tuple of two positive integers that define a range.
The version of the SPDX License List used in the license expression.
Country for which export controls must be taken into account.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ocsp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Online Certificate Status Protocol, or OCSP, is a common scheme used to maintain the security of a server and other network resources.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specification is a detailed document (or set of documents) that describes the requirements, design, behavior, or other characteristics of a system, component, or process so that all stakeholders have a clear, unambiguous reference.
Specifies whether the License is listed as free by the Free Software Foundation (FSF).
A canonical, unique, immutable identifier.
An SPDX Element containing an SPDX license expression string.
HarvestAction represents the act of creating a product by directly extracting goods or materials from nature.
A verificationUUID is a universally unique identifier (UUID) assigned to a Verification item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha1
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-1, a secure hashing algorithm, as defined in [RFC 3174](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3174/).
Provides a CVSS version 3 assessment for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasConcludedLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact is concluded by the SPDX data creator to be governed by each `to` AnyLicenseInfo. If the `to` of an Artifact's `hasConcludedLicense` is not the same as the `to` of its `hasDeclaredLicense`, a written explanation should be provided in the comment field of the `hasConcludedLicense` relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: attend
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, and may involve publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. CISA recommends remediating Attend vulnerabilities sooner than standard update timelines.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentNotPresent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The software is not affected because the vulnerable component is not in the product.
Sponsor of the project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The third-highest level of risk posed by an AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: structured
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is stored in tabular format or retrieved from a relational database.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when the type does not match any of the other options.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: trainedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been trained on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: graph
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is in the form of a graph where entries are somehow related to each other through edges, such a social network of friends.
Specifies the value of the content identifier.
Energy quantity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: x509Cert
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an X.509 certificate as defined in [RFC 1422](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1422/). The media type shall be one of application/x-x509-ca-cert or application/x-x509-user-cert.
ISO level of automation.
This is the planned product associated with the change of responsibility.
Provides an ExternalMap of Element identifiers.
Records the storage of a product.
Specifies a country code where a software service is hosted.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packagedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a packaged instance of the `from` Element (`from` packagedBy `to`).
Information related to hardware dimension.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mailingList
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the mailing list used by the maintainer for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: simpleLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SimpleLicensing profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: patchedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a patch for the `from` Element (`from` patchedBy `to`).
A key with an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rorid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Research Organization Registry (ROR) identifier](https://ror.org/about/) is a unique identifier for research and funding organization, typically expressed in its preferred URI form such as `https://ror.org/02mhbdp94`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contains
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element contains each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: phoneNumber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Phone number; A string of decimal digits that uniquely indicates the network termination point defined in [RFC 3966](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3966/) Section 5.
Links a vulnerability and one or more elements designating the latter as products not affected by the vulnerability.
Inspection Process defines specific various processes needed to satisfy the inspection requirements for a specific product or service.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pretrainedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been pretrained on the `to` Element(s).
The ProcessReadinessType is defined by the enumeration.
An Organization representing the SPDX Project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audio
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is audio based, such as a collection of music from the 80s.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amendedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is amended by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inlineMitigationsAlreadyExist
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Built-in inline controls or mitigations prevent an adversary from leveraging the vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPenTestReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a [penetration test](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penetration_test) report for a package.
A transport route refers to the specific path or network used to move people, goods, data, or resources from one location to another.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: development
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact is in active development and is not considered ready for formal support from the supplier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 256, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).
Conveys information about how VEX status was determined.
A mapping between prefixes and namespace partial URIs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: application
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software application.
An SPDX version 2.X compatible verification method for software packages.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: productMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional product metadata such as reference within organization's product catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasEvidence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is considered as evidence for the `from` Element (`from` hasEvidence `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md5
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD5 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1321](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1321/).
Abstract class representing a license combination consisting of one or more licenses.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: webpage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Absolute URL that can be used to locate a resource, as defined in [RFC 7230](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7230/) Section 2.7.1 or Section 2.7.2.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isil
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Identifier for Libraries and Related Organizations (ISIL)](https://slks.dk/english/work-areas/libraries-and-literature/library-standards/isil/) is a unique alphanumeric code for identifying libraries, archives, museums, and related organizations standardized by [ISO 15511](https://www.iso.org/standard/77849.html). It consists of a prefix—which may be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or a non-country code assigned by the ISIL Registration Authority—followed by a unit identifier, totaling up to 16 characters (e.g., `FI-Sipoo-Sö` or `ZDB-1-SBD`). Valid symbols include any alphanumeric character, solidus (`/`), hyphen-minus (`-`), or colon.

A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).
